QA_10139639:
At TikTok Shop UK, my supervisor asked me to set up a campaign configuration for a list of merchants by hand. Each merchant needed the right setting, and it was slow and repetitive. After doing three to five by hand I could see the logic behind the choices, so I suggested building a small AI agent with Claude Code to do it, with a validation step at the end to check accuracy.

My supervisor was a bit sceptical at first, which was fair, because a wrong setting would affect real merchants. So I made sure the validation step was solid and that the output was easy to check. I delivered it before the same-day deadline, and it cut the time the task took by around 40 to 50 percent.

It wasn't part of what I was asked to do, but I didn't want to just repeat the same manual work every time. What I learned is that building the tool is only half of it. The other half is making it easy for people to trust it.
